slug: 2025-11-14 Angola Nears Completion of National Data Center, Set for 2026 Launch

facts.fact: Ecofin reports the government said that once the national data centre, developed alongside a unified government cloud (about USD 90 million combined), is inaugurated, all government services must migrate to it within 30 days; no date given for the statement, so the document's published date is used.
facts.system: National data centre and unified government cloud (INFOSI)
